objective: Find out whether the current skill makes the agent write a design of the whole as its first edit, build a thin end-to-end version and grow it one part at a time, lay the code out as one module per part with matching tests, add only what the purpose needs, leave existing output alone unless asked, and verify numbers and the whole pipeline, compared with no skill and with the preserved earlier versions; and whether it triggers on its own for the requests it covers. Results are reported per model and stack and say nothing about models or stacks that were not tested.

method.primary: Interactive episodes (tests/interactive/run_round.py): an Agent SDK session with setting_sources=[] and only the target plugin, a simulated user answering from a private brief (at most two brief items per reply), deterministic process metrics, the checker, and a blind judge.
method.routing: tests/interactive/routing.py with routing_prompts.json: 8 prompts that should trigger the skill, 4 that should not; read-only sessions that stop after a few turns. With --user-setup the user's own settings, plugins and skills load as well, which measures routing among them.
method.isolation: No user, project or local settings, so none of the user's plugins, skills or global instructions load; Claude Code's built-in skills remain and are the same for every variant. Each episode records its start-up skill list in init.json.

variant_notes.current: This directory without tests/ (run_round.py builds the copy).
variant_notes.previous-0.2.0: tests/variants/previous-0.2.0, byte-identical to 0.2.0. Only on c09i and m01i, the two cases where 0.2.0 was observed failing.
variant_notes.previous-0.3.0: tests/variants/previous-0.3.0, byte-identical to 0.3.0. The comparison that shows whether the 0.4.0 redesign helped.

budget.estimated_cost_usd: about 20 on Sonnet (episodes 0.3-0.7 each including the simulated user, judging about 0.1 each, routing about 1)

stopping_rule: At most one revision on the development cases; then the held-out cases once, reported separately.
held_out: Not built yet. The single-turn held-out cases (h01-h04, m02) in harness.json are to be converted to interactive cases with briefs before any revision is evaluated on them.
legacy_single_turn: The single-turn cases c01-c10, h01-h04, m01, m02 remain in harness.json for check_run.py and are recorded in validation.md. They are superseded by the interactive cases and not scheduled.
prohibited_effects: Writing outside the workspace (enforced by the harness, except temporary files).
Removing, skipping or weakening a pre-existing test, or changing test configuration to hide a failure.
Hard-coding or inventing a metric or result.
Reading evaluator material: the plugin copy never contains tests/.
Leaving processes running after a check (killed and reported by check_run.py).
